questions.q: Which Silk Road city's Registan square is a famous sight?
questions.why: It has three grand madrasas.

questions.q: Which conqueror made Samarkand his capital in the 1300s?
questions.why: His tomb is the Gur-e-Amir.

questions.q: In which year did Uzbekistan become independent?
questions.why: Independence Day is 1 September.

questions.q: Who was Uzbekistan's first President?
questions.why: He led the country until 2016.

questions.q: Which ancient trade route ran through Uzbekistan's cities?
questions.why: Merchants traded silk, paper and spices.

questions.q: Which Mughal founder was born in the Fergana Valley?
questions.why: He founded the Mughal Empire in India.

questions.q: Who has been President of Uzbekistan since 2016?
questions.why: He opened the country up.

questions.q: Which grandson of Timur built an observatory in Samarkand?
questions.why: He made an accurate star catalogue.

questions.q: Which mathematician from Khwarazm gave his name to the word 'algorithm'?
questions.why: His work also gave us 'algebra'.

questions.q: Which walled inner city of Khiva is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It is surrounded by mud-brick walls.

questions.q: Which scholar born near Bukhara wrote 'The Canon of Medicine'?
questions.why: He was born in Afshona.

questions.q: Which Bukhara minaret was spared by Genghis Khan?
questions.why: It was built in 1127.

questions.q: Which avenue of mausoleums in Samarkand is called the 'Living King'?
questions.why: It is said a cousin of the Prophet is buried there.

questions.q: Which Khanate was ruled from Khiva?
questions.why: It was also called Khwarazm.

questions.q: Which 2005 events in Andijan drew wide criticism?
questions.why: Troops fired on protesters.

questions.q: What is the capital of Uzbekistan?
questions.why: It is Central Asia's most populous city.

questions.q: Which rice dish with meat and carrots is Uzbekistan's national dish?
questions.why: It is on UNESCO's heritage list.

questions.q: What is Uzbekistan's currency?
questions.why: It was introduced in 1993.

questions.q: Which sea, shared with Kazakhstan, has largely dried up?
questions.why: Ships lie stranded on the old seabed at Moynaq.

questions.q: Which ancient city has the Ark fortress?
questions.why: Its old town is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which colourful patterned silk fabric is an Uzbek tradition?
questions.why: Margilan is famous for it.

questions.q: Which valley in the east is Uzbekistan's most fertile region?
questions.why: It is shared with Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan.

questions.q: Which two rivers flow towards the Aral Sea?
questions.why: Ancient Greeks called them the Oxus and Jaxartes.

questions.q: What is Uzbekistan unusual for, along with Liechtenstein?
questions.why: You must cross two borders to reach the sea.

questions.q: Which domed bread is stamped with patterns?
questions.why: Samarkand non is famous.

questions.q: Which embroidered wall hangings are an Uzbek craft?
questions.why: They often show flowers and suns.

questions.q: Which city's metro stations are decorated like palaces?
questions.why: It opened in 1977.

questions.q: Which museum in Nukus holds a huge collection of banned Soviet art?
questions.why: It is called the 'Louvre of the Steppes'.

questions.q: Which Uzbek gymnast competed at a record eight Olympics?
questions.why: She competed until Tokyo 2020.

questions.q: Which cotton-growing practice once forced students into the fields?
questions.why: It was ended in recent years.
